# Biology starter notes

These notes demonstrate automatic organization. Import this file into a study
area: each level-two heading becomes a topic, and level-three headings become
subtopics inside it.

## Cell biology

Cells are the smallest units of living organisms.

### Organelles

- The nucleus stores most of a cell's DNA.
- Mitochondria release usable energy for the cell.

### Cell membrane

The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.

## Genetics

DNA contains the instructions used to build and maintain an organism.

### Inheritance

Genes are passed from parents to offspring.

### Variation

Genetic variation helps explain differences between individuals.
